Questions

What is the difference between Soft Autumn and Soft Summer?

Soft Autumn and Soft Summer are neighbouring colour seasons. They share the same depth and contrast and chroma. The difference is undertone: Soft Autumn is warm-neutral, Soft Summer is cool-neutral.

Can I be between Soft Autumn and Soft Summer?

Yes. Neighbouring seasons share a lot, and many people sit near the border. That's why Season Card shows your closest season and a runner-up.

How do I tell if I'm Soft Autumn or Soft Summer?

Focus on undertone. In daylight, compare a colour from each palette under your chin, for example muted salmon (Soft Autumn) and mauve pink (Soft Summer), and see which makes your skin look more even.
